{{Quote|I train commandos here at Zephyr Base.|[[Raxa Binn]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Zephyr Base''', best known as the '''Rebel Outpost''', was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] military outpost on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]].

==History==
{{Quote|You are now assigned to the Rebel outpost on Rori. You'll be reporting to General Ufwol.|[[Arnecio Ulvaw'op]], to a Rebel pilot|<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>}}
Although [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] was controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] has managed to make the outpost a small but effective base on the moon.<ref name="SWG:RO" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], it was attacked by a unit of [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]], who found information there regarding Rebel sympathizers among the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]].<ref name="TotC">{{SWGTCG|set=Threat of the Conqueror|scenario=Dark Side scenario campaign}}</ref>

Alliance members present on the base in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] included [[Booto Lubble]], [[Raxa Binn]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Vordin Sildor]],<ref name="SWG" /> and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Ufwol]].<ref name="SWG:JtL" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zephyr Base was one of three starports on Rori in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. On the maps it was only called "a Rebel Outpost" or "Rebel Military Outpost". The name "Zephyr Base" was mentioned by Raxa Binn, one of the [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Characters]] at the base.<ref name="SWG" />
